units.rawText: Thank you for your work on rebuilding the Oasis, Cascadia. You too, Slo-Mo.
units.displayText: Thank you for your work on rebuilding the Oasis, Cascadia. You too, Slo-Mo.

spans.text: Thank you for your work on rebuilding the Oasis, Cascadia. You too, Slo-Mo.

units.rawText: Though now that we mention it... I first met you here, in the Oasis.
units.displayText: Though now that we mention it... I first met you here, in the Oasis.

spans.text: Though now that we mention it... I first met you here, in the Oasis.

units.rawText: Yeah... When I first arrived here, I was startled. The place was nothing like what I'd heard—it was completely scarred by war. Even this warehouse area was occupied by the Entropics.

units.rawText: Back then, you not only saved Ksenia, you also helped secure our power supply.
units.displayText: Back then, you not only saved Ksenia, you also helped secure our power supply.

spans.text: Back then, you not only saved Ksenia, you also helped secure our power supply.

units.rawText: That's just what I'm here for as part of the rescue team. Slo-Mo and I will always be the first on the scene, expanding rescue efforts no matter how dangerous the situation is. You can count on us to secure the field, Professor, so you can focus on what needs you most without worry.

units.rawText: In the real world, I've witnessed countless disasters, both natural and man-made. And from them, I've learned one undeniable truth.

units.rawText: No matter how terrible the disaster, people will always come together and move forward.

units.rawText: Thus, I believe the Oasis... and Magrasea... will overcome.
